content.executive_summary: Harrowgate Aerostructures plc is a mid-tier European aerostructures supplier with about 12% of the European wing-rib market. Revenue rose 11% to £1,240 million in 2025, but the EBITDA margin fell to 7.9% as input costs rose faster than contract escalators. A new tariff on aluminium plate and a three-year pay agreement keep cost pressure high in 2026.

company_profile.company_overview: Harrowgate Aerostructures plc makes machined wing ribs, spars and landing-gear parts and employs about 3,100 people across five plants.
